svg.text: Mountain Range: where destroyer smoke pays, by grid cell (team-normalized)

21 games, 132 destroyer smokes. Map average: 10.9k concealed damage per smoke, 8 deaths per 100, cap won 27%. Cells with 8+ smokes are rated; dashed = small n (8 to 14); grey number = n too small to rate.
high cell: 1.4x map average or more
low cell: 0.6x map average or less (left panel only)
Zones (every smoke assigned to its nearest cap):

Cap B: n 49 | 9.8k concealed damage per smoke (median 5.7k) | 8 deaths per 100 | cap won 35% | share of own smokes on this map: Top 6 44%, Rest 32%
Cap C: n 53 | 9.3k concealed damage per smoke (median 2.4k) | 9 deaths per 100 | cap won 21% | share of own smokes on this map: Top 6 31%, Rest 47%
